en: The postcard depicts three different colorful photographs: a panoramic view of a long sandy seaside beach lined with modern hotels, a close-up of a modernist multi-story hotel building, and a swimming pool scene with people relaxing under umbrellas. The name 'ЗЛАТНИ ПЯСЪЦИ' (Zlatni Pyasatsi) is prominently featured in Cyrillic text on a bright yellow background, suggesting a holiday resort atmosphere. The reverse contains multilingual text in Bulgarian, Russian, and Latin script naming Zlatni Pyasatsi (Golden Sands), as well as postal and production information.
